lead_independence.headline: William Reaves Set for Execution in 1986 Killing of Indian River Deputy
lead_independence.lead: William Reaves, 77, is scheduled to be executed Tuesday for the 1986 murder of Indian River County Deputy Richard Raczkowski, with a final appeal still pending before the U.S. Supreme Court. Reaves was set to receive a three-drug lethal injection at 6 p.m. at Florida State Prison near Starke. Indian River County Sheriff Eric Flowers plans to witness the execution, according to prior reporting. Gov. Ron DeSantis denied clemency for Reaves earlier this week.
